quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with its siren and flashing lights is directly behind you in heavy traffic. You cannot move out of its way. What should you do?

options.text: Stop where you are.
Blow your horn.
Force your way into the adjoining lane.
Keep moving slowly until you can get out of its way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep moving slowly until you can get out of its way.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is behind you in heavy traffic, keep moving slowly. Create a path for the emergency vehicle when you can.

questions.question: Drugs can affect your ability to drive safely:

options.text: Only if they are not prescribed by a doctor.
Only when taken with alcohol.
Only when driving at night.
Even if they are prescribed by a doctor.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if they are prescribed by a doctor.
questions.explanation: Many medicines affect your ability to drive safely. Ask your doctor about side effects before taking any new medication.

questions.question: When it starts to sleet or snow, you should:

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clear.
Leave more space between your vehicle and the vehicles ahead.
Approach all vehicles carefully.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: In snowy weather, keep your windshield and mirrors clear. Increase your distance from other vehicles because slippery roads need more stopping distance.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Slow down.
Drive faster.
Drive at the speed limit with caution.
Not drive faster than 20 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see rain, snow, or sleet. These create slippery roads. Safety may require driving slower than the posted speed limit.

questions.question: When a bus is signaling to return to the main road after stopping, you must:

options.text: Honk to let them know you are there.
Move to the left lane.
Yield.
Speed up to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus returning to the main road after stopping. Change lanes, slow down, or stop to let the bus safely enter traffic.

questions.question: It is important to slow down:

options.text: On narrow or winding roads.
At intersections or railroad crossings.
When the road is wet or slippery.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, near pedestrians, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:

options.text: Intersection.
Road curve.
Right turn.
Lane change.

questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Turn on your hazard lights.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights when you cannot see 500 feet ahead. High beams reflect off fog and rain, making it harder to see.

questions.question: Distracted drivers have a higher crash risk when using which of the following?

options.text: CD player
Radio
Cell phone
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: Using a cell phone (including hands-free) or any audio device can distract you and increase crash risk.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and give the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your driving skills and judgment?

options.text: It improves driving skills but harms judgment.
It harms both driving skills and judgment.
It does not affect driving skills or judgment.
It harms driving skills but not judgment.

questions.correctAnswerText: It harms both driving skills and judgment.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time and makes it hard to see clearly. It also hurts your judgment about speed and distance. Alcohol makes you take more risks and lowers your care for safety.

questions.question: What should car drivers know about large trucks?

options.text: They have large blind spots.
They can stop faster than passenger cars.
They need the same space to turn as passenger cars.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They have large blind spots.
questions.explanation: Large trucks have blind spots in front, on the sides, and in back. Do not stay in these areas. Because trucks are bigger and heavier, they need more room to turn and stop than passenger cars.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: Drive slowly through the intersection.
Stop, then go when the way is clear.
Stop, then go only when the light turns green or a green arrow appears.
You can turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go only when the light turns green or a green arrow appears.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must make a full stop. Wait until the light changes to green or a green arrow shows before you go.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: A flashing yellow light will appear soon.
A steady green light will appear soon.
A steady red light will appear soon.
A flashing red light will appear soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steady red light will appear soon.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a steady red light is coming soon.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Go through if there is no traffic coming.
Keep going because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is there.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are at dangerous intersections. Always treat them the same way you treat a stop sign.

questions.question: You find a problem with your vehicle that could affect safe driving. What should you do?

options.text: Fix it as soon as possible.
Fix it when you have money.
Drive slower.
Drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fix it as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Fix any problem that affects safe driving right away. Do not drive the vehicle until it is fixed.

questions.question: Another driver is passing your car. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the road.
Signal to show them when it is safe to pass.
Check for oncoming cars and slow down so they can pass safely.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming cars and slow down so they can pass safely.
questions.explanation: Keep to the right when someone passes you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to help the other driver move back into the right lane safely.

questions.question: A driver entering an interstate from an entrance ramp should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Have the right-of-way.
Force their way into traffic.
Assume other drivers will move over.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering the interstate from an entrance ramp, you must let drivers already on the highway go first. Merge into traffic safely when you have a clear space.

questions.question: When can you go through a stop sign with no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for cross traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.
After slowing to 10 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign with no stop line or crosswalk, come to a complete stop before entering the intersection. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol at a social event, how can you drive safely?

options.text: Drink coffee before driving.
Get a ride home with someone who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before driving.
Wait 30 minutes before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get a ride home with someone who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The best way to stay safe is to get a ride with someone who has not been drinking. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your system. Your body needs about an hour to process one drink.

questions.question: An inattentive driver is a driver who:

options.text: Looks at objects off the road or daydreams while driving.
Looks at a passenger while having a conversation during driving.
Only watches the vehicle in front.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not get distracted by looking at passengers, searching for things in your car, reading, looking at scenery, or daydreaming while driving. Keep looking at the road, check your mirrors often, and look at your dashboard regularly. These safe habits will help you stay focused.

questions.question: A solid white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions, and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions, and you can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction, and you cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction, and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction, and you cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public highway:

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you sit in the back seat.
If you sit in the back of a pickup truck.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or have alcohol while on a public road or sidewalk. You also cannot keep an open alcohol container in the area where the driver or passengers sit on any public road.

questions.question: When changing lanes you should not:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Use your turn signal.
Check for other drivers moving into your lane.
Use your cell phone to call police to check if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call police to check if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal to tell other drivers you plan to change lanes. Check for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane.

questions.question: After stopping for a school bus that is unloading children:

options.text: Wait until children wave at you before moving.
Watch for children walking along the roadside.
Speed up.
Turn on your emergency flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking along the roadside.
questions.explanation: After stopping for a school bus with its stop arm out and lights flashing, watch for children walking along the roadside. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: A flashing yellow traffic light means:

options.text: Merging traffic ahead.
Drive carefully.
Pedestrians are crossing.
Stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells you to slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:

options.text: Use low beam headlights.
Use high beam headlights.
Use parking lights.
Use no lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In rainy conditions, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing with no traffic light, who must yield?

options.text: Whoever started moving last.
The driver.
Whoever is slower.
The pedestrian.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver.
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection without a traffic light, whether or not there is a marked crosswalk.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: T intersection ahead.
Lane shifting ahead.
Side road ahead.
Do not block the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: T intersection ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black symbols and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: An "End school zone" sign means:

options.text: The speed limit is now 20 mph.
A school zone with lower speed limits is starting.
More pedestrians may be present.
The school zone with lower speed limits has ended.

questions.correctAnswerText: The school zone with lower speed limits has ended.
questions.explanation: Follow the school zone speed limit during posted times. An "End school zone" sign shows where the reduced speed zone ends.
